notes.title: Hole Satisfaction Patch v1.1.6
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi all![/h3][h3]See below some fixes and changes.
[b]
Worm Work[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Worm Death Issue Fixed[/b] – Worms now spawn [i]and[/i] die correctly for all clients. No more immortal wrigglers.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Jetpack[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Jetpack Stamina Reduced[/b] – Burn less energy while blasting out your hole.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Ore-ganization[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Ore Pooling Optimization[/b] – Faster pool ore cleanup = smoother host performance in long play sessions.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Core Gun Charging[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Surface Charging[/b] – Core gun now charge just by being on the surface, no need to wait for daytime.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Respawn Fix "Death & Save"[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Respawn Fixed[/b] – You should no longer come back as a shovel or lose your save upgrades on death. Hopefully its all resolved now.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Smooth Dig Deluxe[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Smooth Digging[/b] – Holes are now smoother than ever, helping you carve structured caves and escape your own messes. Thank you everyone for your support :D.

I will send a update soon to a release date for the next free content update![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dressed To Dig Patch 1.1.4
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes – v1.1.4[/h2][h3]Appearance Customization[/h3][list][*][p]You can now [b]change the colour of your clothes and hair[/b] at the fireplace in-game.
Simply interact with the fireplace using [b]E[/b] to open the customization menu.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Optimization[/h3][list][*][p]Further improvements made for [b]Vulkan performance[/b], with a particular focus on potential [b]AMD and Steam Deck performance gains[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]startup music would blast at max volume for 1 second[/b] before switching to your saved audio settings.
This will no longer blow your ears up![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a [b]replication issue with the worm enemy[/b] where it would fail to spawn on clients in multiplayer sessions.[/p][/*][/list][h3]In Progress[/h3][list][*][p]I’m actively working on a [b]brand-new level[/b] featuring a whole new set of [b]purchasable upgrades[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]This will arrive as a [b]free content update[/b] once it’s ready.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Thank You!![/h3][p]I’m a solo developer, and I deeply appreciate all of you who’ve supported me through the launch of my first game. Your patience and encouragement mean the world, thank you![/p]

notes.title: Steam-Dig Optimization Patch V1.1.3
notes.notes:
[h3]Fixes & Further Optimization[/h3][list][*][p][b]Dynamite During Save – FIXED[/b]
Resolved an issue where players could [b]throw dynamite while the game was saving[/b], causing it to be wasted. Dynamite is now blocked during save operations to prevent accidental loss.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Graphics & Performance[/h3][list][*][p][b]Vulkan RHI[/b][/p][p]Vulkan is now fully supported, offering improved compatibility for [b]AMD users[/b] along with support for [b]FSR[/b] and [b]Frame Generation[/b].
[i](Recommended for Steam Deck and AMD GPUs.)[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]DLSS Options Expanded[/b]
Added a toggle to [b]enable/disable DLSS[/b], along with support for [b]DLSS Frame Generation[/b] for compatible NVIDIA GPUs.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Optimization Mode[/b]
A new [b]Steam Deck[/b] checkbox has been added in the settings menu.[/p][list][*][p]Automatically applies optimized settings for best performance and visuals on Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Steam deck is still not perfect frame rate but I am still working on further optimization for it.
[/p][h3]Final Notes[/h3][p]Thank you for playing and digging deep! I’m continuing to push updates and currently working on new content for the game.[/p][p]If you run into any issues or have feedback, don’t hesitate to post in [b]Discussions[/b], I read everything!

Thanks for all your support![/p]

notes.title: Minor Changes Patch
notes.notes: [p]Hi All,[/p][p]I’ve been busy working on [b]new content[/b] to extend the game further and keep those digs exciting![/p][h3]Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p][b]Lightning Underground Fix[/b] – Lightning will no longer flash through when you’re deep underground.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Portable Furnace Stamina Boost[/b] – Depositing ores into the [b]portable furnace[/b] now [b]fully restores your stamina[/b], giving you a nice boost while you keep digging.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Core Gun Prompt[/b] – The [b]Core Gun[/b] will now display a [b]prompt[/b] to return to the surface when depleted, since it [b]recharges over time[/b] on the surface.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Final Notes[/h3][p]Thanks for playing and supporting the game, every bit of feedback helps shape the updates![/p][p]If you find any issues or have ideas, leave a post in the [b]Discussions tab[/b], I’m always reading them! [/p]

notes.title: Dig-Tastic Patch V1.1.2
notes.notes:
[h3]Fixes & Systems[/h3][list][*][p][b]Session Cleanup on Client Leave[/b]:
Fixed an issue where multiplayer sessions wouldn’t fully clear when a client left. Sessions now reset properly on disconnect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Client-Side Air Holes[/b]:
Fixed a bug where air pockets around underground objects were not showing correctly on clients. Visibility should now be consistent for all players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gem Clusters & Breakables Now Save[/b]:
Destroyed [b]gem clusters[/b] and [b]breakable rocks[/b] now remain destroyed after reloading a save. Their destruction state is now saved properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Key Save & Respawn Logic[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]If you [b]die[/b], the key is now [b]dropped at your location[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If you [b]quit the game[/b], the key will [b]respawn at its original spawn point[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]In multiplayer, if a [b]client leaves[/b], the key will also [b]drop at their location[/b] so it isn’t lost.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Stamina Ore Rework[/h3][p]Stamina ores now have [b]distinct names, colors, and stamina effects[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]🔹 [b]Digagra[/b] (Blue) – Restores [b]25% stamina[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🟢 [b]Staminut[/b] (Green) – Restores [b]50% stamina[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔴 [b]Hot Nugget[/b] (Red) – Restores [b]75% stamina[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Emote Wheel[/b]:
You can now use [b]emotes[/b]! Hold [b]Z[/b] to bring up the emote wheel and express yourself in style.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ping System[/b]:
Use [b]middle mouse button[/b] to [b]ping ores, chests, and locations[/b] — perfect for communicating with teammates in multiplayer!
[/p][/*][/list][p]I’ll be away for the weekend and will return to patching and adding new content on [b]Monday[/b].[/p][p]If you run into any issues or have feedback, please leave a post in the [b]Discussions[/b] tab — I’ll check everything when I’m back.

Please remember — I’m a [b]one-man dev[/b], doing everything I can with my [b]Big Dig Dev Energy[/b] to make this the [b]best digging game there is.[/b]
[/p][p]Thanks again for all your support, and have an awesome weekend![/p]

notes.title: Ore-Some Patch V1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569323/d353fffaf569a13b7a2d02572d7509f2e97f0278.png"][/img][/p][h3]Audio[/h3][list][*][p][b]Master Volume Fix[/b]:
Master volume slider now correctly adjusts [b]all sound classes[/b], ensuring consistent audio control across the entire game.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay & World Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Ore Spawn Pooling Fix[/b]:
Resolved a [b]pooling issue[/b] that could cause ore nodes to fail spawning entirely in some areas. You should now see a [b]much more consistent and satisfying amount of ores[/b] when digging.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Underground Object Air Holes[/b]:
World terrain now clears around key underground objects (like [b]chests[/b] and [b]gem clusters[/b]) at runtime, creating [b]air pockets[/b] to make them easier to discover and dig out.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Stamina Ore Tiers[/b]:
Introduced [b]three different tiers of Stamina Ore[/b], each spawning at specific depths. These ores provide [b]minor stamina boosts[/b] to help during deeper digging runs.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance & Stability[/h3][list][*][p][b]Low-End Machine Invoker Fix[/b]:
Fixed an issue where [b]starting areas would not load fast enough[/b] on lower-end machines. World generation is now more responsive and reliable at spawn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto Save Edit Lock (Multiplayer)[/b]:
Voxel edits are now [b]temporarily disabled during Auto Save[/b], preventing game freezes that could cause connection loss for clients.[/p][list][*][p]Auto Save is [b]enabled by default[/b] (saves every 25 minutes).[/p][/*][*][p]You can [b]disable it in Settings[/b] if you prefer manual saves using the house computer or by quitting cleanly.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Final Notes[/h3][p]Thanks for continuing to dig in and sharing feedback. I'm doing everything I can to improve the experience each day, and there's more on the way. You all rock. [/p]

notes.title: Improvements Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Saving & Progression[/h3][list][*][p][b]Character Save Corruption Fix[/b]:
Fixed a critical issue where player progress could become corrupted after dying. This should no longer occur, and your upgrades will be saved reliably.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Level Object Persistence[/b]:
Object positions in the world are now saved properly with your world save. This includes moved or placed objects and helps ensure a more consistent experience between sessions.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Unlocks & Balance[/h3][list][*][p][b]Vacuum Unlock Requirement[/b]:
The [b]Vacuum Tool[/b] now unlocks after depositing [b]100 ores[/b]. This adds a small early-game goal before gaining access to vacuuming features.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Gem Balance Changes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Blue, Purple, and Red Gems[/b] no longer restore stamina.[/p][/*][*][p]Only [b]Stamina Ore[/b] now provides a stamina boost.
This helps clarify item roles and improves stamina progression balance.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Final Notes[/h3][p]Thanks again to everyone playing and sending in feedback. Every bug fix and balance change is helping shape a better game. More improvements + content are coming — stay tuned![/p]
